This is pretty interesting. Another old man hero! Woohoo!

Alright, so his base power is to heal himself? Interesting. My initial thought is that he works like Nightmist, playing cards that will deal himself damage, so he'll need a way to regain HP. He's got a pretty solid HP, so that's good. Color me intrigued.

posts.name: lugaru
posts.cooked:
5 reasons why I like the character so far:

1) He seems almost like a parody of a Chosen One a la Harry Potter.

2) He totally SCHOOLS his oponents.

3) No need for a mask... what are his foes gonna do, blow up his house boat?

4) I dont want power creep on default powers, so his is fairly weak compared to other heroes.

5) And the real reason... molecule control! When people ask me what secret power I want, invisivility or flight, I say control over the very molecules that shape our reality. Then they say "ok, smarty... invisivility or flight?!"
